pages.text: With $(o)Ars Nouveau$() installed, this cable moves source. It behaves exactly like the energy cable: set a face to $(o)extract$() against a source jar or a sourcelink, set the far end to $(o)insert$() against whatever needs feeding, and it flows.$(br2)Without Ars Nouveau it does not exist at all.

pages.title: Rates
pages.text: Source is far scarcer than power, so the upgrades move it a hundred times more slowly than they move FE. A basic upgrade is enough to keep a single apparatus fed; an ultimate one will run a whole workshop.$(br2)Filters have nothing to match on here, so a mana cable ignores them.
